outcome: sonographic accuracy for prediction of small for gestational age (SGA) at birth
sonographic accuracy for prediction of macrosomia at birth
cohort: Women who gave birth at term to a singleton healthy neonate between 2007-2014 and underwent sonographic estimated fetal weight evaluation within 3 days before delivery.
finding: The accuracy of sonographic estimated fetal weight (sEFW) is affected by various clinical and sonographic pregnancy characteristics, leading to false-positive and false-negative diagnoses for small for gestational age and macrosomia.
birth_weight: SGA defined as <10th percentile for gestational age; macrosomia defined as >4000 grams.
